verdict.rationale: Weave documents built-in and custom 'signals' that automatically capture and classify agent interactions, with alerts on what they find. This is a form of continuous, automatic judging of production behavior. However, the core Evaluation workflow is documented as dataset-based, and nothing explicitly says scorers or LLM judges run continuously on sampled live traffic. missing for 10: explicit docs on attaching scorers/LLM judges to live production calls (online evals), sampling and filtering configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets

citations.quote: Built-in and custom signals automatically capture and classify agent interactions, so you always know how your agents are behaving.
Create a custom W\&B Weave signal to tag agent turns for a behavior you define.
Weave provides end-to-end observability to monitor agent behavior, out-of-the-box signals to surface failure modes
